blocks.text: Solvent mein solute ka halna dissolution hai. Solution ka banna teen qadmon mein farz kiya jata hai: solute ke liye jagah banane ke liye solvent mein intermolecular forces par qaboo pana (solvent ko phailana), solute ko alag alag ajza mein torna (solute ko phailana), aur solute aur solvent ko taamul kar ke solution banane dena. Hararat ya to di jati hai ya li jati hai, aur standard enthalpy change of solution ise bayan karti hai.

blocks.title: Standard enthalpy change of solution
blocks.text: Standard enthalpy of solution, delta Hsol, woh hararat hai jo jazb ya kharij ho jab kisi madde ka ek mole solvent mein hal ho kar la-mehdood patla (infinitely dilute) solution de. Yeh exothermic ya endothermic ho sakti hai.

Sodium carbonate exothermic taur par halta hai, Na2CO3(s) + aq se 2Na+(aq) + CO3 2-(aq), delta Hsol = -25 kJ fi mol; ammonium chloride endothermic taur par, NH4Cl(s) + aq se NH4+(aq) + Cl-(aq), delta Hsol = +16.2 kJ fi mol. Heat of solution ki miqdar mil kar solution banane wale ajza ke darmiyan intermolecular forces ki mazbooti ke bare mein batati hai. Ionic compound mazboot electrostatic forces se jure mukhalif charge wale ions par mushtamil hai, aur do awamil us ke halne par qaboo rakhte hain: hydration energy, solute ions ki pani ke molecules se kashish, aur lattice energy, jo ionic compound ke tootne par qaboo rakhti hai.

blocks.caption: La-mehdood dilution par pani mein kuch ionic solids ki heats of solution, kJ fi mol (Table 6.2)

blocks.prompt: Table 6.2 ke sab namak endothermic taur par halte hain, phir bhi asani se halte hain. Kaun si do energies muqable mein hain, aur musbat heat of solution un ke bare mein kya kehti hai?
blocks.explanation: Lattice energy, jo ions ko alag karne ke liye deni hoti hai, hydration energy se muqabla karti hai jo pani ke ions ko gherne par kharij hoti hai. Musbat heat of solution ka matlab hai lattice energy hydration energy se thori zyada hai, to thori hararat mahol se li jati hai; namak phir bhi halte hain kyunke be-tarteebi ka izafa milne ke haq mein hai.

items: Dissolution: solvent phailao, solute phailao, unhen taamul karne do. Delta Hsol: ek mole ke la-mehdood patle solution tak ki hararat, exothermic (Na2CO3 -25) ya endothermic (NH4Cl +16.2, NaCl 4.98, KCl 17.8, NH4NO3 26.0 kJ fi mol); hydration energy banam lattice energy se tai.
